hostChecks: Exact preset geometry, camera, materials and analytic/RNG corpus at every supported size
Strict bounded request schema rejects custom, wave and spectral inputs before runner work
No GPU, no adapter, device failure and compilation failure retain only complete CPU image
Injected success is admitted but cannot claim genuine GPU execution; no shadow is supplied to factory
Altered image, RNG input/output, ownership and audit are rejected
Device loss fallback is separate from admission
Pre-abort, setup abort, late runner, run abort and total deadline withhold results and destroy resources
Worker is inert on load, rejects malformed envelopes, suppresses stale/aborted runs and supports repeated runs
Structured scene fixed dyadic oracle, frozen histograms, schema2 CPU-only comparison at every size

compilation.measurement: Wall time in createShaderModule/getCompilationInfo/createComputePipelineAsync, nested within coldSetupMs; not isolated GPU compiler time

limitations: Single cold, complete-image correctness test with mandatory full CPU shadow.
Renderer wall time includes GPU work, host scheduling, readbacks and selective CPU replay; no timestamp-query GPU-only timing.
No warmed paired benchmark or GPU-versus-CPU speedup claim.
WebGPU may use software; adapter identity is reported when exposed. A physical GPU is not established by this test.
No wave, spectral, custom-scene or unaudited fast mode.
